text:
eve: Short thread to align on a lightweight quant manifest + runtime preflight for canaries. We keep it tiny and flat so on-prem runtimes can validate quickly.

sam: +1. Proposal: author proto in git -> CI produces signed manifest (flat json) -> upload to S3. Runtime reads manifest, verifies signature/hash, checks compat bitmap, then applies or falls back.

mira: Required manifest fields: profile_name, profile_hash, expected_quality_delta, calibration_hash, ops_blacklist[], created_by, release_tag, canary_tag (optional). All strings/arrays only.

sam: Runtime preflight: O(1) checks = signature OK -> bitmap lookup (model_uuid+hw_path) -> success. On failure immediate fallback to fp16; do not try to reconcile.

eve: Rollback/enforcement defaults: quality alert if LL delta > 0.02 OR human-failure-rate > 1%. Auto-fallback if latency +30% or memory +20%. Cost-only regressions -> billing alert.

ops-bot: Reminder: private installs may not access S3. CI artifact must include signed tarball so operators can stage locally; runtime still verifies signature.

sam: Small example manifest snippet for clarity:
```
profile_name: "q4e-fp8-small"
profile_hash: "sha256:aa11bb22"
expected_quality_delta: "0.012"
ops_blacklist: ["grouped_matmul_v2"]
calibration_hash: "sha1:ffee"
release_tag: "r2026-03-23"
```

mira: Action items: Eve -> draft RFC with manifest schema + API surface; Ops -> runbook for distribution; Runtime -> preflight prototype (bitmap). Will open tickets.
